text:
Starting from 100 bar with mix 21/35/44 (O2/He/N).
PARTIAL PRESSURE BLENDING:
 - From 100.0 bars add 35.0 bar Helium to 135.0 bar (16/52/33),
 - From 135.0 bars add 9.3 bar Oxygen to 144.3 bar (21/49/30) ,
 - From 144.3 bars add 55.7 bar air to 200.0 bar.  
Resulting mix will be 21/35/44 (O2/He/N).
